mapper.select:
SELECT SDA. ID, SDA.AUTHORITY_NAME, SDA.REMARK, SDA.CREATE_TIME FROM SMT_DEVICE_AUTHORITY SDA
AND SDA.AUTHORITY_NAME = LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.authorityName},'%')
SELECT SDA.ID, SDA.AUTHORITY_NAME, SDA.REMARK, SDA.CREATE_TIME FROM SMT_DEVICE_AUTHORITY SDA LEFT JOIN SMT_STAFF_DEVICE_AUTH SSDA ON SDA.ID = SSDA.AUTH_ID WHERE SSDA.STAFF_ID = #{staffId}

SELECT DISTINCT SSDA.ID, SS.BADGE, SS.NAME AS PERSON_NAME, SS.STATUS AS staff_status, SSDA.CREATE_TIME FROM SMT_DEVICE_AUTHORITY SDA LEFT JOIN SMT_STAFF_DEVICE_AUTH SSDA ON SSDA.AUTH_ID = SDA.ID LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE_AUTHORITY_RELATION SDAR ON SDAR.AUTHORITY_ID = SDA.ID LEFT JOIN SMT_STAFF SS ON SS.ID = SSDA.STAFF_ID WHERE SDA.ID = #{query.authId} AND SDA.TYPE = 1
AND SS.BADGE in
#{item}
AND SS.NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{query.personName}, '%'))
ORDER BY SSDA.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT SVA.ID, SS.NAME AS PERSON_NAME, SS.STATUS AS staff_status, SV.VEHICLE_PLATE, SVA.CREATE_TIME FROM SMT_DEVICE_AUTHORITY SDA LEFT JOIN SMT_VEHICLE_APPLY SVA ON SDA.ID = SVA.AUTHORITY_ID LEFT JOIN SMT_VEHICLE SV ON SVA.VEHICLE_ID = SV.ID LEFT JOIN SMT_VEHICLE_STAFF SVS ON SVA.VEHICLE_ID = SVS.VEHICLE_ID LEFT JOIN SMT_STAFF SS ON SVS.STAFF_ID = SS.ID WHERE SDA.ID = #{query.authId} AND SDA.TYPE = 3 AND SVA.STATUS = 1 AND SV.VEHICLE_ASCRIPTION != 2 AND SV.IS_DELETE = 0 AND SS.ID IS NOT NULL
AND SS.NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{query.personName}, '%'))
AND SV.VEHICLE_PLATE LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{query.vehiclePlate}, '%'))
ORDER BY SVA.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT DISTINCT SDAR.DEVICE_ID AS deviceId, SD.DEVICE_NAME AS deviceName, SDA2.ID AS conflictAuthorityId, SDA2.AUTHORITY_NAME AS conflictAuthorityName FROM SMT_DEVICE_AUTHORITY_RELATION SDAR LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE SD ON SD.ID = SDAR.DEVICE_ID JOIN SMT_DEVICE_AUTHORITY_RELATION SDAR2 ON SDAR2.DEVICE_ID = SDAR.DEVICE_ID AND SDAR2.AUTHORITY_ID != SDAR.AUTHORITY_ID JOIN SMT_DEVICE_AUTHORITY SDA2 ON SDA2.ID = SDAR2.AUTHORITY_ID WHERE SDAR.AUTHORITY_ID = #{authorityId} AND SDA2.AREA_TYPE != #{targetAreaType}
